Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, move out of its return path to avoid the second hit. Its return damage increases as your health falls, so retreat before it returns if you are below half health. Before Aurora R Between Worlds forms, escape its area or close in prepared to fight inside it.
Aurora.build: Complete one core item first. Build magic resistance over armor against Aurora’s main damage, and get movement speed to leave telegraphed areas. If the healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration is a problem, add Executioner's Calling afterward.
Aurora.fight: Make Aurora use Aurora E The Weirding to create distance, then look for a chance to close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash. However, further pursuit remains possible if Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora R Between Worlds are still available, so aim for the tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade after more mobility abilities have been used.
Aurora.combo: If Aurora moves out of position, use Aatrox E Umbral Dash during Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade to adjust the sweet spot.
Aurora.escape: Your opening to engage is when both Aurora E The Weirding and Aurora W Across the Veil are down.
Aurora.teamfight: When you can reliably force a fight, activate Aatrox R World Ender and engage. Group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains to hit several with the sweet spot of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, and aim it at enemies caught by your allies’ immobilizing crowd control. If Aurora leaps in and no one has been killed, that is a chance to catch her. When retreating, do not leave low-health allies behind.

Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, he will follow with an auto attack, Darius W Crippling Strike, and Darius Q Decimate, so poke from outside its range. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move beyond the blade or get close to him to reduce its damage and healing. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks up, create distance to let the stacks fall off. If you are low on health with several stacks, get completely out of range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Darius.build: Buy Cloth Armor or Bramble Vest first to withstand Darius’s main physical damage, and get Plated Steelcaps early. If you keep falling behind, build both armor and health to account for the penetration on Darius E Apprehend and the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine. If the healing from Darius Q Decimate is a problem, add Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Darius.fight: When Darius E Apprehend misses or is down, use Aatrox E Umbral Dash to line up your sweet spot and trade damage. End long fights as Darius P Hemorrhage stacks up, then look for another opening.
Darius.escape: Your opening to engage is when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. Once you engage, create distance to let Darius P Hemorrhage stacks fall off when they start building up.
Darius.teamfight: Gain a numbers advantage with your allies, then activate Aatrox R World Ender when you can reliably start a fight. Group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains and hit several with the sweet spot of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. If you are low on health with several Darius P Hemorrhage stacks, retreat completely so you do not give Darius a kill and cooldown reset with Darius R Noxian Guillotine.

Chogath.watch: Cho'Gath Q Rupture knocks you up after a warning appears beneath you, so move sideways immediately when you see it and use Aatrox E Umbral Dash to dodge if needed. Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences you from the front and prevents you from using mobility, so do not start a trade while standing in front of him. At half health or lower, keep your distance because of the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast and its increased range from stacks.
Chogath.build: Complete one core item first. If the healing from Cho'Gath P Carnivore is a problem, add Executioner's Calling afterward. Build magic resistance against Cho'Gath Q Rupture, Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, and Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes, while accounting for the fact that resistances cannot reduce the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast.
Chogath.fight: After dodging Cho'Gath Q Rupture or seeing him use it on the wave, adjust your distance with Aatrox E Umbral Dash to land the sweet spot of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. Do not start a long trade in front of him while Cho'Gath W Feral Scream is available.
Chogath.laning: Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes passes through minions, so step out of the line of his auto attacks.
Chogath.combo: If your first Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade misses, do not waste Aatrox W Infernal Chains. You can use Aatrox E Umbral Dash during Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade to adjust the sweet spot.
Chogath.escape: Your opening to engage is just after Cho'Gath uses Cho'Gath Q Rupture on the wave or you dodge its warning. Cho'Gath has no mobility skill, so close the distance with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and connect Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade with Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences you, do not try to cast; walk out first.
Chogath.phase: Aatrox is strongest in the mid game as he gains ability haste and items. Cho'Gath grows stronger as he gains stacks, so pressure him early instead of giving him time to reach the late game, and do not give him a kill when your health is borderline.
Chogath.teamfight: Gain a numbers advantage with your allies, then engage with Aatrox R World Ender. Group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains to hit several with the sweet spot of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, and aim Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade at enemies caught by your allies’ immobilizing effects. Dodge the warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture sideways, and leave the range of Cho'Gath R Feast when you fall to half health or lower.

DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits only the first target and deals damage based on current health, so use minions as cover to dodge it, especially when you have high health. Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases ignores the first immobilizing effect, so do not engage expecting Aatrox W Infernal Chains to pull him while his passive is available. Dr. Mundo heals and gains speed when he activates Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage, so do not spend time trying to kill him.
DrMundo.build: Build armor first to account for the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper deal magic damage, which armor does not reduce. If his healing is a problem, add Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
DrMundo.fight: After Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down, follow up with Aatrox W Infernal Chains and subsequent hits of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. Avoid a long duel if Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active.
DrMundo.laning: Block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw by standing behind minions. After a trade, step on the dropped canister as you retreat to deny Mundo its healing and passive cooldown reduction.
DrMundo.escape: Engage when Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw either is blocked by a minion or misses, and Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down. Mundo has no skill to create distance on his own, so close in with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and connect Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade with Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
DrMundo.phase: Aatrox reaches his peak in the mid game as he gains ability haste and items. In the late game, when Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is available, do not fixate on killing Mundo; shift your advantage to another lane or an objective.
DrMundo.teamfight: Gain a numbers advantage with your allies, then activate Aatrox R World Ender and engage when you can reliably force a fight. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, trigger it first, then group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains to hit several with the sweet spot of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. When an ally’s immobilizing effect lands, follow it with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.

Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot uses walls to engage from a distance and stun. Stand away from walls. When her hook attaches to a wall, look for a chance to interrupt her leap with the forced movement from Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Camille.build: Against the physical damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, Camille W Tactical Sweep, and Camille E Hookshot, buy Cloth Armor or Bramble Vest first and get Plated Steelcaps earlier. If you are losing, build armor and health to survive, but remember that armor does not reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, and the damage from Camille W Tactical Sweep scales with maximum health. If the healing from Camille W Tactical Sweep is a problem, fit in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Camille.fight: While Camille E Hookshot is still available as a counter, take short trades. Once it is down, adjust your distance with Aatrox E Umbral Dash, then follow up with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Camille.laning: Stand away from walls and among minions to limit Camille E Hookshot's engage angles.
Camille.escape: Your opening comes after you dodge the stun from Camille E Hookshot or interrupt her leap. If Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is also down, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and land Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If only one of Camille's mobility tools is down, do not rush in; she can escape with the other.
Camille.phase: Aatrox is strongest in the midgame, as ability haste and items build up.
Camille.teamfight: Engage after creating a numbers advantage with your team. Group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains and hit several of them with the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. It is easier to land Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade on enemies held by an ally's immobilizing crowd control. Activate Aatrox R World Ender just before a fight when you can reliably force it.

Akali.watch: Once the mark lands, a second dash will follow, so leave yourself room to adjust your distance with Aatrox E Umbral Dash.
Akali.build: If you are losing early, prioritize health and regeneration to stay in lane. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Akali's damage, and get health so you do not easily fall into execution range. Movement speed to leave a telegraphed attack area is also useful.
Akali.fight: If Akali comes out of Akali W Twilight Shroud to attack, answer with the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. While Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali R Perfect Execution are down, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash.
Akali.combo: Adjust your position with Aatrox E Umbral Dash immediately after pressing Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade to land its edge even during the cast.
Akali.escape: Do not go deep just because Akali W Twilight Shroud is down. Your opening is after Akali E Shuriken Flip is also down and before Akali R Perfect Execution comes off cooldown. Approach with Aatrox E Umbral Dash, then chain Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade into Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Akali.phase: Aatrox is strongest in the midgame, so use that window. Do not insist on duels in the late game.
Akali.teamfight: Engage after creating a numbers advantage with your team. When you can reliably force a fight, activate Aatrox R World Ender, group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains, and hit several of them with the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. If an ally lands immobilizing crowd control, follow it with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.

Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte blocks the knockup from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and the pull from Aatrox W Infernal Chains; blocking an immobilizing effect also lets it stun. Watch for Fiora moving toward the vital marked by Fiora P Duelist's Dance. If she uses Fiora R Grand Challenge, stand against a wall to block one vital.
Fiora.build: Against the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework, buy Cloth Armor or Bramble Vest first and get Plated Steelcaps earlier. If you keep losing, build armor and health to survive, but remember that armor does not help against the true damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and Fiora R Grand Challenge, and the damage from Fiora R Grand Challenge scales with maximum health. If Fiora's healing is a problem, fit in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Fiora.fight: Right after Fiora uses Fiora Q Lunge, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash.
Fiora.escape: Right after you make Fiora use Fiora Q Lunge is your chance to close the gap. If Fiora W Riposte is also down, approach with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and chain Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade into Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Fiora.phase: Aatrox is strongest in the midgame, as ability haste and items build up.
Fiora.teamfight: Group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains and hit several of them with the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. Also land its edge on enemies immobilized by allies. If Fiora targets you with Fiora R Grand Challenge, stand against a wall so she cannot hit all four vitals.

Garen.watch: The empowered basic attack from Garen Q Decisive Strike silences you and prevents a counterattack, so do not engage first while he has it ready. Garen E Judgment deals more damage the longer you stay close, so leave its spinning range. Right after Garen uses Garen W Courage, he gains a shield and tenacity; delay Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains by half a beat. If you are below half health, beware Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on missing health, and stay out of its range.
Garen.build: Against the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment, buy Cloth Armor or Bramble Vest first and get Plated Steelcaps earlier. If you keep losing, build armor and health first to survive. If the healing from Garen P Perseverance is a problem, fit in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Garen.fight: Take a short trade right after the empowered basic attack from Garen Q Decisive Strike is spent. When Garen E Judgment is spinning, disengage instead of fighting him up close for long.
Garen.laning: Then push and pressure the lane to give Garen less time to build stacks on Garen W Courage. Once you have pushed the wave through, create a numbers advantage elsewhere.
Garen.escape: Your opening is right after Garen uses the empowered basic attack from Garen Q Decisive Strike on a minion or spends it. Garen has no mobility ability, so close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and hold him with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If Garen activates Garen W Courage, delay your crowd control by half a beat.
Garen.teamfight: Engage after creating a numbers advantage with your team. Group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains and hit several of them with the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. When you can reliably force a fight, activate Aatrox R World Ender just before it starts, and follow an ally's immobilizing crowd control with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.

Illaoi.watch: Illaoi E Test of Spirit pulls out your soul and slows you, so last-hit from outside its range during lane. When Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active, her tentacles hit harder. Keep your distance and avoid fighting among them.
Illaoi.build: Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash, and Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deal mainly physical damage, so consider an early Cloth Armor or Bramble Vest and buy Plated Steelcaps sooner. If you keep falling behind, build armor first to survive. If her healing is the problem, finish one core item, then buy Executioner's Calling so you have healing reduction before a dive.
Illaoi.fight: Right after Illaoi uses Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and follow with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. Avoid extended fights while Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active.
Illaoi.laning: Last-hit from outside the range of Illaoi E Test of Spirit so you can avoid it.
Illaoi.combo: Use Aatrox E Umbral Dash during Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade to adjust where the blade's tip lands.
Illaoi.escape: Your opening to engage comes right after you make Illaoi use her mobility tool, Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash, and catch her with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Illaoi.phase: Aatrox is strongest in the mid game, once he has built up ability haste and items.
Illaoi.teamfight: Destroy Illaoi's tentacles when you can. If that is difficult, draw her away from walls. Illaoi R Leap of Faith creates a tentacle for each champion hit, so do not group up. When she uses it, spread out and wait for it to expire. When engaging, activate Aatrox R World Ender, group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains, and hit several of them with the tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.

Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!'s cone deals true damage, so step sideways as she casts it. Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework deal damage based on maximum health, and Gwen R Needlework also slows, so keep your distance. While Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you can target Gwen from outside, so enter the mist or wait for it to end.
Gwen.build: Consider an early magic resistance item such as Spectre's Cowl against Gwen's main damage. Resistances cannot stop the true damage at the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, so dodge it with positioning. Her high armor makes physical damage less effective, so add armor penetration. If her healing is a problem, fit in Executioner's Calling after finishing one core item.
Gwen.fight: Right after Gwen uses Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, adjust your distance with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and follow with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. Avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! while fighting, and do not stay close to Gwen for long once she has built up stacks.
Gwen.escape: Your opening to engage comes right after you make Gwen use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. Close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash, then chain the knock-up from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade into the pull from Aatrox W Infernal Chains. Gwen E Skip 'n Slash can come back more easily around many minions, so fight on the side with no minions.
Gwen.teamfight: Engage with your team, group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains, and hit several of them with the tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. When you can reliably force a fight, activate Aatrox R World Ender just before engaging. Layer Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade onto an ally's immobilizing crowd control, and keep avoiding the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.

Gnar.watch: Gnar Q Boomerang Throw can hit you both on the way out and on the way back, so step out of its path. Mega Gnar's Gnar R GNAR! stuns if it knocks you into a wall, so avoid standing with a wall behind you or fighting in tight spaces. Watch his rage bar and appearance, and avoid a head-on fight when he is close to transforming.
Gnar.build: Against the physical damage from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Gnar Q Boulder Toss, Gnar E Hop / Gnar E Crunch, and Gnar R GNAR!, buy Cloth Armor or Bramble Vest first and get Plated Steelcaps sooner. If you keep falling behind, build armor and health to survive, but do not stack only health: the magic damage from Gnar W Hyper / Gnar W Wallop bypasses armor and scales with maximum health.
Gnar.fight: Do not force trades into Mini Gnar's poke. Fight after Gnar E Hop is down or right after he changes from Mega to Mini. Close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash, then land the tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. Right after he transforms into Mega Gnar, back away and wait instead of taking a head-on fight.
Gnar.laning: Step out of Mini Gnar's Gnar Q Boomerang Throw path so he cannot catch it on the return. This gives you more time before his next poke.
Gnar.escape: Gnar E Hop / Gnar E Crunch is Gnar's only mobility tool, so engage with Aatrox E Umbral Dash right after you make him use it. Once Mega Gnar's Gnar R GNAR! is down, use the opening when he can no longer knock you into a wall and stun you. Right after he changes from Mega to Mini, look for an all-in: he cannot transform again for a while.
Gnar.teamfight: Watch Gnar's rage bar and start a teamfight with your allies right after he changes from Mega to Mini. Avoid standing with a wall behind you or fighting in tight spaces, where Gnar R GNAR! can stun you against a wall. When you can reliably force the fight, activate Aatrox R World Ender, group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains, and hit several of them with the tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.

Gangplank.watch: Gangplank E Powder Keg becomes more dangerous as it primes. Look for a trade near a freshly placed keg, but back away from a primed keg or a spot where two kegs overlap. Gangplank W Remove Scurvy clears the crowd control from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains, so watch whether he has used it. Resistances cannot reduce the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage.
Gangplank.build: Against poke from Gangplank Q Parrrley and physical damage from Gangplank E Powder Keg, buy Cloth Armor or Bramble Vest first and get Plated Steelcaps sooner. If you keep falling behind, build armor and health first. If the healing from Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is a problem, fit in Executioner's Calling after finishing one core item.
Gangplank.fight: Take a short trade right after Gangplank places Gangplank E Powder Keg, when no primed keg is nearby. Use Aatrox E Umbral Dash during Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade to adjust your position and land the blade's tip.
Gangplank.combo: If you miss the first blade tip, do not throw Aatrox W Infernal Chains into empty space. Layer the chains right after the first hit knocks Gangplank up to give him less time to walk out of their area.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own. When he has just placed Gangplank E Powder Keg and no primed keg is nearby, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash. While Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, catch him with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Gangplank.phase: Aatrox is strongest in the mid game, as he builds up ability haste and items.
Gangplank.teamfight: Create a numbers advantage with your team, then activate Aatrox R World Ender and engage when you can reliably force a fight. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains and hit several of them with the tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. Time objective fights around whether Gangplank has used Gangplank R Cannon Barrage.

Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to close the gap, so keep your distance when minions are about to die. Watch for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If Irelia R Vanguard's Edge traps you, wait until the blades disappear.
Irelia.build: Complete one core item first. If the healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge becomes a problem, fit in Executioner's Calling. The source does not specify which type of resistance to build.
Irelia.fight: Right after Irelia uses Q Bladesurge, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash, then follow up with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Irelia.escape: Your opening is right after you force Irelia to use Q Bladesurge. Close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and land Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Irelia.teamfight: Prioritize Irelia so she has no time to control the teamfight with Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet. Once your team has a numbers advantage, activate Aatrox R World Ender and engage. Group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains, then hit several of them with the tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.

Jax.watch: Jax E Counter Strike negates basic attacks, then ends with an area stun and damage based on maximum health. Since Jax Q Leap Strike lets him close the gap, use Aatrox E Umbral Dash carefully so you can disengage.
Jax.build: If you fall behind in lane, prioritize health and regeneration to hold on. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so consider both armor and magic resistance. Because Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on maximum health, also consider reducing attack speed instead of relying on a large health pool alone.
Jax.fight: Trade after Jax E Counter Strike is down. Right after you force Jax to use Q Leap Strike, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and land the tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If Jax E Counter Strike is active, stop using empowered basic attacks and leave the stun radius.
Jax.escape: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, back out of its stun radius. If he follows with Jax Q Leap Strike, create distance with Aatrox E Umbral Dash. Once both Jax Q Leap Strike and Jax E Counter Strike are down, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and pressure him with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax engages with Jax E Counter Strike active, spread out and keep your distance until the area stun ends. Then follow up with your team, chaining Aatrox W Infernal Chains and Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade onto Jax.

KSante.watch: If K'Sante lands consecutive Q Ntofo Strikes or builds stacks on minions, move beyond the next shockwave's range and hold Aatrox E Umbral Dash. When K'Sante starts charging W Path Maker, save Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains until its damage reduction and crowd control immunity end, and dodge sideways out of the dash path. Do not stand with your back to a wall where K'Sante R All Out can push you over it.
KSante.build: Build armor against K'Sante's main damage. If his physical damage is a problem, buy Cloth Armor or Bramble Vest first, then get Plated Steelcaps sooner. Use health to withstand the true damage from K'Sante W Path Maker. If you keep falling behind, prioritize armor and health. K'Sante's high armor makes Aatrox's physical damage less effective, so add armor penetration when you need more damage.
KSante.fight: Do not fight K'Sante while he is charging W Path Maker. Dodge the dash, then use Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. When K'Sante R All Out is active, his health and resistances are lower, so focus your damage on him with your team.
KSante.laning: Do not waste the empowered basic attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance on minions.
KSante.escape: After K'Sante has used both W Path Maker and E Footwork, you have an opening to close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash. Confirm that you have also dodged the empowered shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, then follow up with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If K'Sante R All Out is still on cooldown, he has fewer ways to escape.
KSante.teamfight: Land the tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade on enemies caught by an ally's immobilizing crowd control. Group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains to hit several with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. Focus K'Sante with your team during K'Sante R All Out. If the fight will last a long time, make sure your team has a way to reduce healing.

Jayce.watch: When Jayce has his cannon out, watch for ranged poke. If you see Jayce E Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q Shock Blast may follow, so sidestep out of its line. When he has his hammer out, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow.
Jayce.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Jayce's main damage. However, magic resistance will not block the physical damage from Jayce Q Shock Blast. If you fall behind in lane, sustain through it with health and regeneration, but do not rely on stacking health alone: Jayce E Thundering Blow deals damage based on maximum health.
Jayce.fight: Jayce is strong early, so avoid forcing fights at first. After he leaps with Jayce Q To the Skies!, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and aim for the tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.
Jayce.laning: Jayce Q Shock Blast travels in a straight line, so move side to side while farming.
Jayce.escape: Right after Jayce uses the leap from Q To the Skies! is your chance to engage. If the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow is also down, close in with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and lock him down with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, so farm defensively.
Jayce.teamfight: Look for an opening to engage after Jayce uses the leap from Q To the Skies!. Activate Aatrox R World Ender when you can reliably start the fight. Group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains and hit several with the tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. If an ally immobilizes an enemy, follow up with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.

Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast slows and reduces armor and magic resistance, so avoid a direct hit. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals damage based on missing health, so be especially careful when low. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, do not unload your damage; use Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains to lock her down and wait out the invulnerability.
Kayle.build: Complete one core item first. If the healing from Kayle W Celestial Blessing becomes a problem, fit in Executioner's Calling. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Kayle's damage. Avoiding Kayle Q Radiant Blast matters too, since it lowers your resistances.
Kayle.fight: Catch Kayle before she gains movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing, then take short trades while using Aatrox E Umbral Dash to line up the blade's edge. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is available, use crowd control during the invulnerability and deal damage after it ends.
Kayle.combo: While casting Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, use Aatrox E Umbral Dash to adjust your position and land the blade's edge.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility ability, but she can slow you with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and escape using the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing. When Kayle Q Radiant Blast misses or she uses Kayle W Celestial Blessing, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and catch her with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is down too, you have an opening to deal damage.
Kayle.teamfight: Kayle attacks from the back, so find a path to reach her directly from the side or out of vision, and time your engage with your allies' crowd control. When Kayle R Divine Judgment activates, use crowd control to wait out the invulnerability, then focus your damage after it ends.

Kennen.watch: Three stacks of Kennen P Mark of the Storm stun you, so back off briefly when you have two stacks. Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken hits only the first target, so stand behind minions to avoid the poke. Do not stay inside Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom while it is active.
Kennen.build: If you are losing lane, prioritize health and regeneration to survive. Build magic resistance rather than armor against damage from Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, Kennen W Electrical Surge, and Kennen E Lightning Rush.
Kennen.laning: Stand behind minions to block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, and step forward briefly only to last-hit.
Kennen.escape: As soon as Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash. If you have two stacks of Kennen P Mark of the Storm, back off first and engage after the stacks expire.
Kennen.phase: Aatrox is strongest in the mid game, when he has built up ability haste and items.
Kennen.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to avoid the area stun from Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, and keep vision on the places Kennen could engage from. When you can reliably force a fight, activate Aatrox R World Ender and engage. Group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains so the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade hits several of them.

Kled.watch: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, use Aatrox E Umbral Dash to create distance before it pulls you in. When Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, its max-health-based damage is concentrated on the fourth basic attack, so don't stay close enough to take all four hits. Keep in mind that Kled can escape Aatrox W Infernal Chains if his E Jousting and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are still available.
Kled.build: Buy Cloth Armor or Bramble Vest first against Kled's main damage, and get Plated Steelcaps earlier. If you keep falling behind, build armor and health to survive, but avoid stacking too much health alone because Kled W Violent Tendencies and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deal damage based on maximum health.
Kled.fight: Back off when Kled W Violent Tendencies activates, then fight again. Before engaging, check whether Kled can escape with Kled E Jousting or Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!. Once Kled is dismounted, create distance if you cannot finish him before his Courage fills.
Kled.laning: After dismounting Kled, push him away from the minion wave so he cannot gain Courage by killing minions.
Kled.combo: While casting Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, use Aatrox E Umbral Dash to adjust where the blade's edge lands.
Kled.escape: Do not engage just because Kled E Jousting is down; check whether Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is still available. Before Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! comes back, especially when Kled E Jousting is also down, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and land Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you instead, use Aatrox E Umbral Dash to escape before it pulls you in.
Kled.phase: Aatrox is strongest in the mid game, when he has built up ability haste and items.
Kled.teamfight: Keep vision on the flanks to prepare for Kled's long-range engage with Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!. If you cannot stop the engage, keep your tank in front and enter once you and your allies have a numbers advantage. Activate Aatrox R World Ender just before entering the fight, then group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains so the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade hits several of them.

Malphite.watch: Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you, making it hard to engage or retreat, so do not start a trade immediately after it hits. Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains cannot interrupt Malphite R Unstoppable Force, so watch for engage angles from bushes and behind walls when Malphite is out of sight.
Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first against damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, Malphite E Ground Slam, and Malphite R Unstoppable Force. When dealing damage, account for Malphite's high armor by using the maximum-health damage from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance, and add armor penetration if needed.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then take short trades when you can damage his actual health. Do not start a fight immediately after Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits you. Once Malphite E Ground Slam is down, position with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and aim to land the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.
Malphite.laning: Minions cannot block Malphite Q Seismic Shard, so do not stay in its range for long.
Malphite.combo: If the blade's edge is misaligned, adjust with Aatrox E Umbral Dash while casting Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.
Malphite.escape: While Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down, Malphite has no mobility tool, so close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash. Then land Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains to make it hard for him to escape. Delay your engage immediately after Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you.
Malphite.teamfight: Keep some distance from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force cannot knock up several of you at once, and do not group up when Malphite's position is unknown. Engage with your allies after Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down, and activate Aatrox R World Ender when you can reliably start the fight. Group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains so the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade hits several of them.

Mordekaiser.watch: If Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp pulls you in, you're likely to take Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise in succession, so keep your distance in front of him. Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates after three hits, so take short trades and back off. When Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don't enter its range alone; your team can't help you inside.
Mordekaiser.build: Build magic resistance first against Mordekaiser's main ability damage. Consider armor for his basic attack damage too, but don't stack only health because Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise scales with maximum health. If healing from Mordekaiser W Indestructible becomes a problem, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Mordekaiser.fight: Take short trades, landing only one or two hits before Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates, then back off. Don't unload your damage immediately after Mordekaiser W Indestructible grants a shield; focus him after the shield wears down or is converted into healing. When going in, cast Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and use Aatrox E Umbral Dash to position its sweet spot.
Mordekaiser.combo: If the first hit misses, don't cast Aatrox W Infernal Chains into empty space.
Mordekaiser.escape: Mordekaiser has no mobility ability, so after Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is used, you have a chance to close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash. But if Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready and you would have to enter its range alone, don't go in.
Mordekaiser.phase: Aatrox reaches his strongest point in the mid game as he gains ability haste and items.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Go in after gaining a numbers advantage with your team, and spread out so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp cannot pull in several of you at once. Activate Aatrox R World Ender when you can force a fight, then group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains and hit several with the sweet spot of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. If an ally immobilizes an enemy, land Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade on them.

Nasus.watch: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike gains permanent stacks, so don't let him last-hit freely. If Nasus W Wither catches you alone, escaping is difficult; don't move through its range alone. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces armor, so don't stay in its area. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, keep your distance and wait out its duration unless you have a clear numbers or damage advantage.
Nasus.build: Nasus's main damage source, Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, deals physical damage, so build armor first. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces armor, and Nasus R Fury of the Sands deals damage based on maximum health, so don't rely on stacking health alone; leave the area of Nasus E Spirit Fire.
Nasus.fight: While casting Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, adjust your position with Aatrox E Umbral Dash to land the sweet spot, and use the empowered basic attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance on a champion. While Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, stop fighting unless you have a clear advantage.
Nasus.laning: Early on, let the wave come toward you instead of pushing it to Nasus's turret, denying him a safe spot to last-hit and stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Since Nasus has no escape besides Flash, call for a jungle gank when the wave is on your side.
Nasus.combo: If the first hit misses, don't cast Aatrox W Infernal Chains into empty space.
Nasus.escape: Go in when Nasus W Wither is down. Nasus has no ability to create distance himself, so close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and hold him with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, go in only with a clear advantage.
Nasus.phase: Aatrox is strongest in the mid game, so use your control then, but avoid solo duels in the late game as Nasus Q Siphoning Strike stacks build up.
Nasus.teamfight: Don't treat full health as a reason to fight Nasus head-on while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active; keep your distance. After gaining a numbers advantage with your team, activate Aatrox R World Ender just before the fight and go in. Group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains to hit several with the sweet spot of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, and land its sweet spot on enemies immobilized by allies.

Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow reduces armor and slows, helping him approach. Move in the opposite direction from where the axe lands to stop him from picking it up. While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, the movement impairing effects of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains won't work on him, so keep your distance and wait for it to end.
Olaf.build: Against Olaf's physical damage, buy Cloth Armor or Bramble Vest first and get Plated Steelcaps earlier. If you keep falling behind, prioritize armor and health. Armor cannot reduce the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing, so build health too.
Olaf.fight: While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, keep your distance instead of fighting him up close. After it ends, if Olaf is in a position where he cannot escape, adjust your distance with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and follow up with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Olaf.laning: Move away from where the axe from Olaf Q Undertow lands to stop him from picking it up.
Olaf.combo: Immediately after casting Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, adjust your position with Aatrox E Umbral Dash to land the sweet spot.
Olaf.escape: Olaf has no ability to create distance himself, so after Olaf R Ragnarok ends, you have a chance to hold him with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. Stop him from picking up the axe from Olaf Q Undertow to cut off his approach, then close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early, so avoid giving up kills and safely play for time.
Olaf.teamfight: While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don't try to hold him with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade or Aatrox W Infernal Chains; fall back behind your team. When it ends, land the sweet spot of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade on enemies immobilized by allies. When you can go in with your team, activate Aatrox R World Ender, group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains, and hit several with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.

Ornn.watch: The pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture is also terrain that Ornn E Searing Charge can hit to knock you up, so move away from the pillar and walls toward open space. If the final flame from Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, keep your distance until the effect ends to avoid the follow-up damage and crowd control. Even after you dodge the first pass of the elemental from Ornn R Call of the Forge God, Ornn can send it back, so move out of the line between the elemental and Ornn.
Ornn.build: In a losing lane, prioritize health and regeneration so you can sustain and keep trading with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so don't focus on only one type of resistance. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about stacking only health.
Ornn.laning: Land the sweet spot of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade as Ornn last-hits, but be aware that Ornn E Searing Charge can easily knock you up near a pillar or wall. If Ornn tries to craft an item in lane, get close and attack him to interrupt the crafting.
Ornn.escape: You have a chance to go in after Ornn E Searing Charge is used, but if Ornn R Call of the Forge God is still available, he can escape with it too. In particular, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash before Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes back up, then follow with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Ornn.teamfight: Avoid the line between Ornn and the elemental summoned by Ornn R Call of the Forge God, and position with its return after the first pass in mind. Go in with a numbers advantage alongside your team, group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains, and hit several with the sweet spot of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. When you can force a fight, activate Aatrox R World Ender just before going in.

Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault is a targeted stun, so stay out of its range. Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the direction he faces; stop attacking from the front and wait for it to end, or move to his side. When you see the warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of the landing area.
Pantheon.build: Pantheon deals mostly physical damage, so buy Cloth Armor or Bramble Vest first and get Plated Steelcaps early. If you keep falling behind, build armor and health to survive, but do not stack only health because Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on maximum health. Pantheon has relatively high armor, so include penetration when building for damage.
Pantheon.fight: When Pantheon E Aegis Assault starts, stop attacking from the front. Attack after it ends, or use Aatrox E Umbral Dash to reposition and strike from the side.
Pantheon.laning: Keep minions between you and Pantheon Q Comet Spear poke.
Pantheon.escape: Engage when Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and he cannot use its stun or dash. If Pantheon R Grand Starfall is still unavailable, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash, then catch him with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If only one of Pantheon's movement options is down, check whether the other is available.
Pantheon.teamfight: Gain a numbers advantage with your team, then activate Aatrox R World Ender and engage when you can reliably force a fight. Group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains and hit several with the sweet spots of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. If an ally lands immobilizing crowd control, follow it with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.

Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, retreat beyond her basic attack range and let the mark expire; the empowered attack hurts. Stay behind a line of minions to avoid Quinn Q Blinding Assault, and do not force an engage while Quinn E Vault is available.
Quinn.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor or Bramble Vest first and get Plated Steelcaps early. Build armor against Quinn's damage. If you keep falling behind, prioritize health too so you can stay in lane.
Quinn.fight: Do not try to engage Quinn alone while Quinn E Vault is available. Right after she uses it, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and land a sweet spot of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade for a short trade.
Quinn.laning: If you lose track of Quinn, place vision along the side lane and jungle routes. Call out a Quinn R Behind Enemy Lines roam as soon as you see it.
Quinn.combo: If a sweet spot is misaligned, adjust your position with Aatrox E Umbral Dash during the cast of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.
Quinn.escape: Quinn E Vault is an escape that pushes away a nearby opponent while moving Quinn back, so hold your engage until she uses it. Right after Quinn E Vault, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and follow with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Quinn.phase: Aatrox is at a disadvantage against Quinn's range early, so preserve your health and CS.
Quinn.teamfight: Engage after gaining a numbers advantage with your team, and activate Aatrox R World Ender when you can reliably start the fight. Group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains and hit several with the sweet spots of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. If Quinn comes in from the flank, lock her down with crowd control and take her out with your team.

Poppy.build: Buy armor items first to reduce Poppy's main damage. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking only health. Do not build magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.fight: If you knock Poppy up with a sweet spot, layer Aatrox W Infernal Chains over it to continue the combo. Do not use Aatrox E Umbral Dash while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active. Poppy gains more armor even when her health is low, so commit deep only when you are sure you have enough damage to finish her.
Poppy.laning: If you can step on the shield dropped by Poppy P Iron Ambassador first, deny her the shield.
Poppy.combo: Use Aatrox E Umbral Dash to adjust your position during Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade when Poppy W Steadfast Presence cannot stop the dash.
Poppy.escape: Right after you force Poppy E Heroic Charge is a chance to close the gap. Confirm that Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended, then approach with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and follow with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Poppy.phase: Aatrox is strongest in the mid game, as he gains ability haste and items.
Poppy.teamfight: Create a numbers advantage with your team before engaging. When you can reliably force a fight, activate Aatrox R World Ender just before engaging. Use Aatrox W Infernal Chains to group enemies, then hit several with the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade; if an ally has immobilizing crowd control, follow up with Q on top of it. Wait to engage with Aatrox E Umbral Dash while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, and move sideways out of the way when you see Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict charging.
Poppy.watch: While Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, using Aatrox E Umbral Dash will stop the dash and briefly prevent you from using movement abilities, so wait for it to end or reposition on foot. Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so stay in open space. If you’re hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, walk out of the zone before the second hit detonates. When you see Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict charging, move sideways out of its path.

Riven.watch: Riven can cover a long distance by chaining Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor, so back away when you see her first dash. If Riven W Ki Burst catches you, her follow-up basic attacks and abilities are easy to land; knock her up with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade as soon as she reaches you to break the combo. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her range and attack damage increase, and Wind Slash becomes more dangerous as the amount of missing health increases. Keep your distance until it ends.
Riven.build: Riven deals physical damage, so build armor first. If you are losing trades, buy Cloth Armor or Bramble Vest first and get Plated Steelcaps early. If you keep falling behind, build armor and health to survive.
Riven.fight: Take a short trade when Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions. If she engages first, knock her up with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and layer Aatrox W Infernal Chains over it to interrupt her follow-up attacks.
Riven.laning: If Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions, counterattack briefly. Do not waste the empowered basic attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance on a minion.
Riven.escape: Do not engage just because Riven Q Broken Wings is down; check whether she has also used Riven E Valor. In particular, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and land Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains before Riven Q Broken Wings comes back.
Riven.phase: Aatrox reaches his peak in the mid game, as he gains ability haste and items.
Riven.teamfight: Engage with your team, group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains, and hit several with the sweet spots of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. If an ally lands immobilizing crowd control, follow it with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. When you can reliably force a fight, activate Aatrox R World Ender just before engaging.

Renekton.watch: When Renekton's Fury bar from Renekton P Reign of Anger is above or just below half, watch for the empowered stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator and stay out of range. Renekton E Slice and Dice can use minions to set up a second dash, so do not stand in or behind the wave.
Renekton.build: Against Renekton's main damage, buy Cloth Armor or Bramble Vest first, get Plated Steelcaps earlier, and prioritize armor. If you keep falling behind, build armor and health to survive. If the healing from Renekton Q Cull the Meek is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Renekton.fight: Take short trades when Renekton has no Fury or right after he uses Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice. If Renekton E Slice and Dice is down, use Aatrox E Umbral Dash to get into range, then land the blade tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and use Aatrox W Infernal Chains to stop his escape.
Renekton.escape: Go in after Renekton uses Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage and his dash is down, provided the stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator is also down. Close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash, then follow up with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Renekton.phase: Aatrox is strong in midgame as he gains ability haste and items, so avoid giving up kills and reach that point.
Renekton.teamfight: Go in after creating a numbers advantage with your team, and activate Aatrox R World Ender when you can reliably force a fight. Group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains and hit several with the blade tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. If an ally lands crowd control that prevents movement, follow up with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.

Rumble.watch: Taking both shots of Rumble E Electro Harpoon in succession increases the slow and reduces your magic resistance. If the first shot hits, use Aatrox E Umbral Dash to create distance before the second arrives. Do not stay near Rumble for long if you want to reduce the damage from Rumble Q Flamespitter.
Rumble.build: If you need a defensive item, choose one with magic resistance first. Rumble E Electro Harpoon reduces magic resistance, while Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking only health.
Rumble.fight: If Rumble activates Rumble W Scrap Shield, delay your burst damage until the shield disappears. Once its movement speed boost also ends, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash.
Rumble.laning: If the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon hits, do not extend the trade; dodge the second shot.
Rumble.combo: If the blade tip is out of position, adjust it with Aatrox E Umbral Dash during the cast of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility ability, so the opening to catch him comes after the movement speed boost from Rumble W Scrap Shield ends. If you dodge Rumble E Electro Harpoon or can move before its second shot arrives after the first, engage with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and follow up with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Rumble.teamfight: When an ally lands crowd control that prevents movement, hit the target with the blade tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. Group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains to hit several with the blade tip, and activate Aatrox R World Ender just before engaging when you can reliably force a fight.

Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker is especially dangerous right after Sett takes heavy damage. If you deal heavy damage, back off briefly and wait for his Grit to decay. If dodging is difficult, move sideways out of the center of its targeting line to avoid the true damage. Sett E Facebreaker stuns if there are targets on both sides of Sett, so do not get caught between the minion wave and Sett.
Sett.build: Against Sett's basic attacks and Sett Q Knuckle Down, buy Cloth Armor or Bramble Vest first and get Plated Steelcaps earlier. If you keep falling behind, build armor and health to survive, but remember that Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on maximum health and armor cannot reduce the true damage at the center of Sett W Haymaker.
Sett.fight: After dealing damage, back off to watch for Sett W Haymaker, then fight again once his Grit decays. While Sett R The Show Stopper is down, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and follow up with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Sett.escape: The window while Sett R The Show Stopper is down is your chance to engage. If Sett E Facebreaker is down or you are positioned where it cannot stun, approach with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and land Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Sett.phase: Aatrox is strongest in midgame as he gains ability haste and items.
Sett.teamfight: Engage with your team, group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains, and hit several with the blade tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. If an ally lands crowd control that prevents movement, follow up with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. Activate Aatrox R World Ender just before engaging when you can reliably force a fight.

Shen.watch: If Shen E Shadow Dash taunts you, you will take basic attacks empowered by Shen Q Twilight Assault, so mind your distance to leave room to dodge the dash. When Shen uses Shen Q Twilight Assault, step out of the path the spirit blade takes as it passes through you on its way back to Shen. Save the empowered basic attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance while inside Shen W Spirit's Refuge, and attack with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.
Shen.build: Prioritize tenacity against the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage and Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so do not focus on only one type of resistance. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking only health.
Shen.fight: If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and counterattack. If Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, save the empowered basic attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance until it ends.
Shen.laning: Gain lane control and keep Shen occupied with CS to make it harder for him to use Shen R Stand United to intervene in another lane.
Shen.combo: Use Aatrox E Umbral Dash during the cast of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade to adjust the blade tip, then use the empowered basic attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance after Shen W Spirit's Refuge ends.
Shen.teamfight: If Shen disappears from lane or you see him channeling Shen R Stand United, alert your team immediately and fight only if you can end the fight before he arrives. After creating a numbers advantage with your team, group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains and hit several with the blade tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. If you can reliably force a fight, activate Aatrox R World Ender just before engaging.

Sion.watch: When Sion Q Decimating Smash starts charging, use Aatrox E Umbral Dash to move sideways and avoid the stun and knockup. Sidestep Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught instead of running forward or backward, and avoid meeting him in narrow passages. When Sion revives through Sion P Glory in Death, reposition to avoid his rapid attacks and damage based on maximum health.
Sion.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught.
Sion.fight: Once Sion Q Decimating Smash is down, take a short trade, using Aatrox E Umbral Dash to adjust where Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade lands. Right after Sion activates Sion W Soul Furnace, focus damage on the shield to break it before it explodes.
Sion.laning: If you keep giving up CS to Sion, his maximum health will grow. Disrupt his farming or gain an advantage in another lane.
Sion.combo: Use Aatrox E Umbral Dash right after casting Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade to adjust your position and make its blade tip easier to land.
Sion.escape: If Sion Q Decimating Smash is also down, close the distance with Aatrox E Umbral Dash, then combo Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade with Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Sion.phase: Pressure Sion so he cannot keep increasing his maximum health through CS, and do not let the game drag into the late game while ignoring him.
Sion.teamfight: Enter after gaining a numbers advantage with your team, and activate Aatrox R World Ender when you can reliably start the fight. Group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains to hit several with the blade tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, and follow allied immobilizing crowd control with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. After Sion falls, reposition to avoid his attacks after Sion P Glory in Death revives him.

TahmKench.watch: If you think Tahm Kench has applied two stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste, move out of range and wait for them to expire. Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash can slow, stun, and heal, while Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive knocks up enemies in an area. When you see his dive animation, spread out from your teammates.
TahmKench.build: Build magic resistance first against Tahm Kench's main damage. Consider penetration because his high armor limits Aatrox's physical damage. If healing becomes a problem, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
TahmKench.fight: If you deal a little damage to Tahm Kench and back off, he can gain a shield or heal with Tahm Kench E Thick Skin. Commit your damage when his counterattack tools are down. If Tahm Kench has applied two stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste, stop fighting and retreat.
TahmKench.combo: If the first hit misses, do not cast Aatrox W Infernal Chains into empty space. If the blade tip is misaligned, adjust during the Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade cast with Aatrox E Umbral Dash.
TahmKench.escape: Enter when the crowd control from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash is down. Close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash, knock him up with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, then hold him with Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
TahmKench.teamfight: When you see the animation for Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, spread out from your teammates so it cannot knock up several of you. Instead of trying to kill Tahm Kench first, pressure the carry he is protecting with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains, accounting for a possible rescue with Tahm Kench R Devour. If he swallows an ally, focus damage on the slowed Tahm Kench. Activate Aatrox R World Ender just before the fight when you enter.

Singed.watch: Do not chase a low-health Singed through Singed Q Poison Trail. If Singed R Insanity Potion is active, leave the trail because the poison also reduces healing. You cannot use Aatrox E Umbral Dash on Singed W Mega Adhesive, and Singed E Fling will also root you if it hits you there, so go around the adhesive.
Singed.build: Singed Q Poison Trail and Singed E Fling deal magic damage, so consider magic resistance first. Singed E Fling also deals damage based on maximum health, so get movement speed to escape the poison trail instead of heavily stacking health alone.
Singed.fight: If Singed W Mega Adhesive or Singed E Fling is down, use Aatrox E Umbral Dash to line up Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and take a short trade. If Singed runs away with Singed R Insanity Potion active, do not chase unless you have enough damage to finish him.
Singed.laning: Pressure Singed safely early to force him to recall.
Singed.combo: Adjust your position during the Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade cast with Aatrox E Umbral Dash to land the blade tip. If the first Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade misses, do not cast Aatrox W Infernal Chains into empty space.
Singed.escape: Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so enter when Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling are down. Check that there is no adhesive underfoot, then close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and hold him with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Singed.phase: Singed becomes hard to kill once he has his core items. Pressure him early to force a recall, and fight alongside your team rather than taking solo duels late.
Singed.teamfight: When Singed charges in, hold him with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains, then attack his teammates instead of chasing him all the way. After gaining a numbers advantage with your team, activate Aatrox R World Ender and enter, hitting several enemies with the blade tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. Watch which way Singed is facing and what lies behind him so Singed E Fling does not throw you into the enemy team.

Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact stuns you if he catches you and collides with a wall, so do not stand with your back to one. The empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval and Skarner P Threads of Vibration are dangerous up close, so do not stay in melee range for long. Aatrox E Umbral Dash cannot break the suppression from Skarner R Impale, so stay far enough away to avoid it.
Skarner.fight: Right after forcing Skarner to use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash. Avoid long trades in which you repeatedly take the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval.
Skarner.escape: The moment Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, his movement ability, goes down is your chance to enter. Close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash, then chain Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact makes you collide with a wall, he may re-engage sooner, so retreat and account for his next charge.
Skarner.phase: As Skarner builds tank items, both his damage and ability to catch targets become harder to handle. Secure early objective control to delay his item timings.
Skarner.build: First decide whether you need a way to break the suppression from Skarner R Impale. If building resistance, prioritize magic resistance against Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval deal damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about choosing to stack health alone.

Teemo.watch: If Teemo Q Blinding Dart hits you, your basic attacks will miss. While blinded, deal damage with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade or back away. Teemo R Noxious Trap is hidden and slows you, so take care near objectives and in narrow paths. In brush without vision, watch for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare's stealth and the attack speed he gains when it ends.
Teemo.build: Build magic resistance first against Teemo's main damage. If you fall behind in lane, health and regeneration can also help you hold on.
Teemo.fight: Trade right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is used. The poison from Teemo E Toxic Shot continues after even one basic attack, so stay outside Teemo's range if you are not ready to close in.
Teemo.combo: If Teemo Q Blinding Dart blinds you, wait until the blind ends before using basic attacks.
Teemo.escape: When Teemo Q Blinding Dart is used, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash. Teemo has no way to create distance besides Teemo W Move Quick, so once you reach him, keep him there with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Teemo.phase: Aatrox is strongest in the mid game, as ability haste and items build up.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap from key paths, and move as though traps are present near objectives and in narrow passages. Engage with your team, group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains, and hit multiple targets with the blade tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. If you can reliably force a fight, activate Aatrox R World Ender just before engaging.

Trundle.watch: Trundle Q Chomp reduces your attack damage, so back away until the effect ends. Do not fight on Trundle W Frozen Domain, and move sideways when Trundle E Pillar of Ice appears, before it slows you. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, create distance or attack another target.
Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Trundle R Subjugate deals damage based on maximum health and reduces resistances, so do not rely solely on stacking more health or resistances. If healing from Trundle P King's Tribute is a problem, add Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Trundle.fight: Fight again after the attack damage reduction from Trundle Q Chomp and Trundle W Frozen Domain end. If Trundle E Pillar of Ice has also been used, use Aatrox E Umbral Dash to position to land the blade tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.
Trundle.laning: Because of Trundle P King's Tribute, do not drag out fights near a minion wave that only chip away at health. After reducing health, secure an advantage immediately or push the wave to force a recall.
Trundle.escape: Engage when Trundle E Pillar of Ice has been used and you can fight outside Trundle W Frozen Domain. Also wait out the attack damage reduction from Trundle Q Chomp and the empowered period of Trundle R Subjugate. Then close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and hold him with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Trundle.teamfight: Create a numbers advantage with your team near an objective before engaging. Activate Aatrox R World Ender when you can reliably start the fight, group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains, and hit multiple targets with the blade tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, create distance from Trundle or attack another target.

Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere P Battle Fury makes his critical strikes stronger. If he is building Fury by hitting minions, create distance early because he may soon engage. Critical strikes reduce the cooldown of Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, so do not chase him where there are many minions. While Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, he cannot die; buy time with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains, or create distance.
Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere's main damage is physical, so buy Cloth Armor or Bramble Vest first and get Plated Steelcaps sooner. If you keep falling behind, build armor and health first to survive. If healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust becomes a problem, add Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Tryndamere.fight: Right after you force Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and land Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. While Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, create distance instead of pouring on damage, then attack again after it ends.
Tryndamere.laning: Hit Tryndamere with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade as he goes for a last hit to make it harder for him to build Fury.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is used, you have a chance to engage with Aatrox E Umbral Dash. Follow up with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. When you need to retreat, face Tryndamere and walk backward to avoid the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout.
Tryndamere.phase: Aatrox reaches his peak in the mid game as ability haste and items build up.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Engage with your team, group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains, and hit multiple targets with the blade tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. If an ally lands immobilizing crowd control, land Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade on that target. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is available, do not try to stop him alone in a side lane; send more teammates or trade for an objective.

Udyr.watch: Right after Udyr activates Udyr E Blazing Stampede, watch for the stun on his first hit. Avoid taking prolonged damage from the empowered basic attacks of Udyr Q Wilding Claw and the maximum health damage of Udyr R Wingborne Storm. Immobilizing effects do not work during the awakened form of Udyr E Blazing Stampede, so use Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains after it ends.
Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr's main damage. Armor cannot stop the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, though, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals mixed damage, so avoid stacking large amounts of health alone. If healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle becomes a problem, add Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Udyr.fight: When the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone, use Aatrox E Umbral Dash to line up the blade tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and keep up pressure. Do not give Udyr time to heal.
Udyr.laning: Udyr shows himself when he ganks from the jungle, so keep vision on paths and jungle entrances. Do not move forward when he is out of sight.
Udyr.combo: If the first hit misses, do not cast Aatrox W Infernal Chains into empty space. Use Aatrox E Umbral Dash during the cast of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade to line up its blade tip.
Udyr.escape: Right after you force Udyr E Blazing Stampede, you have a chance to close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash. If you have taken one stun, counterattack or escape during the period when the same target cannot immediately be stunned again. After the awakened form of Udyr E Blazing Stampede ends, restrict his movement with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Udyr.phase: Aatrox is strongest in the mid game, as ability haste and items build up.
Udyr.teamfight: Do not try to burst down Udyr first when he has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle. Take out the vulnerable allies at the back first, then fight him with a numbers advantage. Activate Aatrox R World Ender when you can reliably force a fight, group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains, and hit multiple targets with the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.

Urgot.watch: Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on maximum health, so do not stay near him for long. When Urgot Q Corrosive Charge comes at you, decide whether to use Aatrox E Umbral Dash immediately to avoid its strong slow and focused fire from Urgot W Purge. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of Urgot's range before you reach the execution threshold.
Urgot.build: Buy Cloth Armor or Bramble Vest first and get Plated Steelcaps early for armor against Urgot's main damage. Because Urgot P Echoing Flames scales with maximum health, avoid stacking health alone. If you keep falling behind, build both armor and health to survive. Urgot tends to have high armor, so consider penetration when choosing damage items.
Urgot.fight: Right after you make Urgot use Urgot E Disdain is your chance to close the gap. Approach with Aatrox E Umbral Dash, land the tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, trade briefly, then leave his short range before Urgot P Echoing Flames triggers repeatedly.
Urgot.combo: If the tip is misaligned, adjust with Aatrox E Umbral Dash during the cast of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.
Urgot.escape: Right after you make Urgot use Urgot E Disdain, go in with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and land Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If you need to dodge Urgot Q Corrosive Charge or escape after being hit, use Aatrox E Umbral Dash to get out.
Urgot.phase: Aatrox grows stronger in the mid game as he gains ability haste and items, so use the opening after Urgot E Disdain is spent.
Urgot.teamfight: Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so stand with your allied frontline to reduce the angles from which he can catch allies behind you. When engaging with your team, group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains and hit several with the tips of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. If you can reliably force a fight, activate Aatrox R World Ender just before going in.

Volibear.watch: When Volibear runs at you with Volibear Q Thundering Smash active, stay outside his empowered basic attack range and move toward your team instead of fleeing in a straight line. When the marker for Volibear E Sky Splitter appears, sidestep to avoid its damage and slow. Volibear W Frenzied Maul can heal him, so end the trade if you cannot finish him.
Volibear.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, Volibear W Frenzied Maul, and Volibear R Stormbringer. If the healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item. Volibear E Sky Splitter deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Volibear.fight: If Volibear has built stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm by hitting minions, do not take the fight; wait for the stacks to expire. Once Volibear Q Thundering Smash and Volibear R Stormbringer are spent, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and fight.
Volibear.escape: Engage after both Volibear Q Thundering Smash and Volibear R Stormbringer are spent, especially before Volibear R Stormbringer is available again. Close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and use Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains to keep Volibear from leaving.
Volibear.teamfight: If Volibear has stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm, do not take the fight immediately. When you can engage with your team, activate Aatrox R World Ender, group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains, and hit several with the tips of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. If Volibear R Stormbringer is available, do not stay under your turret at low health; retreat farther back.

Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare a whirlwind, wait outside its range for the stacks to expire. When he enters with Yone E Soul Unbound, his return can deal additional damage, so heal beforehand or move out of range if your health is low. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls enemies along its path, so before a teamfight, check that you are not standing alone at the very back of your formation.
Yone.build: In a losing lane, you can prioritize health and regeneration to stay in lane. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so do not focus on only one type of resistance. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Yone.fight: When Yone dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, look for a chance to stop his return with the knockup from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Yone.laning: Yone is also weak early, so instead of pushing too hard, chip away at his health with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade when he moves to last hit.
Yone.escape: Engage when the whirlwind stacks from Yone Q Mortal Steel have expired and neither Yone E Soul Unbound nor Yone R Fate Sealed is available. If only one movement option is spent, wait longer because he can escape with the other. When the opening comes, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and land Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Yone.teamfight: Space out from your allies so the shield from Yone W Spirit Cleave does not grow larger, and avoid lining up along Yone's path of entry. When you can reliably start a fight, activate Aatrox R World Ender, group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains, and hit several with the tips of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. If an allied immobilizing effect lands, follow it with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.

Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and deals damage based on maximum health, so watch its projectile path and dodge it. If Yorick W Dark Procession traps you, break the wall by attacking it or dash over it with Aatrox E Umbral Dash. If the Maiden of the Mist starts attacking you, move away from Yorick, and clear the Mist Walkers before fighting.
Yorick.build: Build armor first to account for the physical damage from Yorick Q Last Rites and his Mist Walkers. Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles deal magic damage based on maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone. If the healing from Yorick Q Last Rites is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Yorick.fight: Do not start a fight where many graves have built up or when Yorick approaches with Mist Walkers. Yorick has no mobility ability, so when you have an opening to engage, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and catch him with Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Yorick.laning: When you can push, make the minions die under the enemy turret so Yorick cannot clear the wave and build up graves on his side.
Yorick.combo: If the first hit misses, do not cast Aatrox W Infernal Chains into empty space.
Yorick.escape: You have an opening to engage after dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist or when Yorick W Dark Procession is on cooldown. Yorick has no mobility ability, so get close with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and follow up with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Yorick.teamfight: Engage after gaining a numbers advantage with your team, and activate Aatrox R World Ender when you can reliably force a fight. Group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains and hit several of them with the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. If an ally immobilizes an enemy, land Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade on them.

Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so sidestep out of its path when he approaches. After Yasuo lands Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice, his next cast sends a tornado that knocks you up; watch for its sound and visual effect and dodge early. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade lets him close the gap through minions, so mind your spacing when there are many minions nearby.
Yasuo.build: Against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath, buy Cloth Armor or Bramble Vest first and get Plated Steelcaps earlier. If you keep falling behind, prioritize armor and health to survive in lane. Remember that armor does not reduce the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.fight: Remove the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer with light poke before committing to a trade. The moment just after Yasuo fires his tornado and his Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks reset is an opening to engage.
Yasuo.laning: Manage the wave so it pushes thinly toward your side, leaving Yasuo fewer minions to use to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.escape: Look to engage just after Yasuo fires his tornado, when his Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks reset. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade has a short cooldown, so do not overcommit just because he used it once. Before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up, close the gap with Aatrox E Umbral Dash and follow up with Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Yasuo.teamfight: Engage when you and your allies have a numbers advantage, and activate Aatrox R World Ender when you can reliably force a fight. Group enemies with Aatrox W Infernal Chains to hit several with the blade tips of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. Layering Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade over an ally's immobilizing crowd control makes the blade tips easier to land.
